items.mainDefect: The server-side guests schema and handler do not dedupe emails within one request, so duplicate emails in a single request create duplicate Attendee rows.

secondary.defect: There is a check-then-insert race (TOCTOU): concurrent requests both pass the existing-attendee check and insert duplicate attendees.

items.mainDefect: The blacklist check compares un-lowercased guest emails against a lowercased blacklist, so a different casing bypasses the blacklist.

secondary.defect: The existing-attendee duplicate check (guest === attendee.email) is case-sensitive, so the same email with different casing creates a duplicate attendee.

items.mainDefect: findFirstOrThrow with booking.userId || 0 throws an unhandled 500 when the booking's userId is null.

secondary.defect: The extra organizer query is redundant because booking.user is already loaded by the first booking query.

items.mainDefect: The server-side existing-attendee dedupe check is case-sensitive, so the same mailbox with different casing is added as a duplicate attendee.

secondary.defect: The client-side Set-based uniqueness check in AddGuestsDialog.tsx is also case-sensitive.

items.mainDefect: The blacklist check compares the raw guest email against a lowercased blacklist, so a different casing bypasses the blacklist.

secondary.defect: The attendee duplicate comparison on line 76 is also not case-normalized.

items.mainDefect: The error message comes from a template literal and is always truthy, so the unable_to_add_guests fallback can never be reached.

secondary.defect: The user-facing error toast is always prefixed with an internal TRPC error code (or 'undefined').
